history.summary: Generously-sized 1130 sqft 2BR at Tanglin View (D03 Redhill) for $1.98M / $1752 PSF — ~7% below the $1875 district median — 360m from Redhill MRT, with a solid 5.1%/yr appreciation on a reliable 69-txn series. Sub-median pricing in the liquid band plus doorstep MRT and RCR/GSW upside make this a modest Buy, tempered by the 2002 age and lease decay.
history.rating_rationale: Asking PSF $1752 is ~7% below the $1875 median on a reliable 69-txn series, $1.98M sits in the deepest buyer-pool band, and 360m to EW18 Redhill MRT plus D03's Greater Southern Waterfront/TEL upside support demand. 5.1%/yr appreciation is RCR-grade. The 2002 build (24 years, lease ~76yr remaining) and a middling 563 score are the offsets, but a below-median, well-located, well-sized 2BR is a sound value entry.
